title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals secrets through dream-sharing technology is offered a chance to erase his past by planting an idea in a target's mind.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A ten-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, where humans are changed into beasts.

title: Parasite
overview: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy household by posing as unrelated, highly qualified workers.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime and faces a criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Heneral Luna
overview: General Antonio Luna leads the Philippine army in the Philippine–American War while battling divisions within his own government.

title: Coco
overview: Aspiring musician Miguel is transported to the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travels through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: Your Name
overview: Two teenagers who have never met discover they are mysteriously swapping bodies, and set out to find each other.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a new spaceman action figure becomes his owner's favourite toy.

title: The Matrix
overview: A computer hacker learns that the world he lives in is a simulation and joins a rebellion against its machine controllers.

title: Get Out
overview: A young man visits his girlfriend's family for a weekend and uncovers a disturbing secret behind their hospitality.

title: La La Land
overview: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a drifter and a rebel commander flee across the desert from a tyrannical warlord.

title: Hello, Love, Goodbye
overview: Two Filipino overseas workers in Hong Kong fall in love while each is set on a plan that could pull them apart.

title: The Godfather
overview: The ageing patriarch of an organised crime dynasty transfers control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: A laundromat owner discovers she must connect with versions of herself in parallel universes to save the multiverse.

title: Train to Busan
overview: Passengers on a high-speed train fight for survival as a zombie outbreak spreads across South Korea.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: A timid clownfish sets out across the ocean to bring his son home after he is captured by a diver.

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb.

title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.

title: A Quiet Place
overview: A family must live in silence to hide from creatures that hunt by sound.

title: Up
overview: An elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with a young stowaway aboard.

title: Gladiator
overview: A betrayed Roman general is forced into slavery and rises through the arena to avenge his family.
